title: StrucSure Home Warranty
description: StrucSure Home Warranty is a leading provider of new home warranties and risk management solutions for home builders, contractors, and homeowners across the United States. The company offers comprehensive coverage options, including structural, workmanship, and systems warranties, backed by reinsurance from Lloyds of London. StrucSure aims to protect builders and homeowners from potential defects and financial liabilities while providing tailored insurance solutions to meet diverse needs. Their services also include warranty administration and marketing support to enhance builder-client relationships.
